localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 天域碎片已修正：充能不再超出容量，累计100厘点即可转为1点魔力。
localized.en_us: Ethereal Shards cannot overfill; every accumulated 100 centivis becomes one vis.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 源质反应炉已修正：仅从底面接收实际消耗的源质，空输入不能延长发电。
localized.en_us: Essentia Dynamos accept fuel only from below and require actual essentia to extend generation.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 因果重组器已修正：合并需要两节点中实际存在的魔力，并从各自节点扣除；仅有容量不再足够。
localized.en_us: Recombination requires stored vis in both nodes and deducts it from the correct node; capacity alone is insufficient.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 魔力反应炉已修正：多个消费者共享同一刻的输出上限，重新加载也不能重复取满。
localized.en_us: Vis Dynamo consumers share one output budget per tick, including across reloads.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 活化粉已修正：成功活化消耗一份粉末；可活化材料由现代方块标签确定。
localized.en_us: Successful animation consumes one powder. Modern block tags determine eligible materials.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 活化回收已修正：方块或物品成功还原后才移除傀儡；失败时保留并重试。
localized.en_us: Animated golems remain until their block or item is successfully restored; failed returns retry.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 血液炼金已修正：每剂最多8点已发现要素，成品槽满时停止吸取；候选效果用尽后不再追加无效效果。采血样本不复制装备或库存。
localized.en_us: Blood formulas use at most eight units of discovered aspects. Full output stops intake; exhausted effect lists add no invalid effect. Blood samples do not copy equipment or inventories.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 针筒发射器已修正：装填保留名称与附魔，弹药成功发射后才扣除。
localized.en_us: Injector loading preserves names and enchantments; ammunition is spent only after a projectile is successfully spawned.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 化身之缸已修正：收齐全部源质并成功培育后才消耗样本和营养；更换样本会重新计算费用，喂食也实际消耗饥饿源质。
localized.en_us: Incarnation consumes its sample and nutrients only after all essentia is supplied and the clone is created. Changing samples recalculates costs; feeding consumes Fames.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 治愈之缸已修正：只接收当前所需源质；缸中玩家离线时仍占据缸体，不会被克隆过程覆盖。
localized.en_us: Curative Vats accept only required essentia. An offline occupant still occupies the vat and cannot be overwritten by cloning.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 生物注魔已修正：相同原料不会重复充当多份材料；开始后保存配方与消耗进度，重载不会改变本次费用。
localized.en_us: Creature infusions match ingredients individually and preserve the started recipe and consumption progress across reloads.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 生物强化已修正：保存、重载或克隆不会重复叠加同一种速度与攻击强化。
localized.en_us: Saving, reloading and cloning no longer stack the same speed or attack augmentation repeatedly.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 收容核心已修正：必须持续瞄准同一目标，实心方块阻挡光束；乘骑中的生物不能单独捕捉。释放失败时保留罐中生物。
localized.en_us: Containment requires a continuous beam on the same target and cannot pass through solid blocks or split a riding pair. Failed releases preserve the jarred creature.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 邪术毒牙已修正：强化生物成功攻击时对受害者施毒，不再在自己受击时错误中毒。
localized.en_us: Eldritch Fangs poison the victim of a successful attack instead of poisoning their owner when struck.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 符文皮毛已修正：不足1点的伤害也会扣除相应护盾；配方使用正确的研究门槛。
localized.en_us: Runic Hide pays shield charge for fractional damage too; its recipe uses the correct research requirement.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 忠诚生物已修正：近战攻击遵守冷却，不再每刻攻击一次。
localized.en_us: Loyal creatures respect melee cooldowns instead of attacking every tick.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 自剪羊适配新版：只有成年且羊毛已长回时才产出羊毛。
localized.en_us: Self-shearing sheep produce wool only when adult and ready to be sheared.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 觅食猪已修正：抵达食物后正常进食；遵守生物破坏规则、领地保护与世界边界，不破坏有方块实体的容器。
localized.en_us: Foraging pigs eat after reaching food and respect mobGriefing, protection and world borders; they do not destroy block-entity containers.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 地狱猎犬已修正：火焰被实心方块阻挡，不能隔墙伤害目标。
localized.en_us: Nether Hound fire is blocked by solid blocks and cannot hit through walls.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 梦魇马旅行已修正：找不到容纳坐骑与骑手的安全落点时拒绝传送；成功转移后才触发出发地爆炸。
localized.en_us: Nightmare travel requires a safe landing for both mount and rider; the departure explosion occurs only after transfer succeeds.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 灵魂信标适配新版：实际死亡才触发转生，图腾救命或护甲挡下致命伤不会提前换体。
localized.en_us: Soul Beacons trigger on actual death; a Totem rescue or armor preventing lethal damage does not replace the body.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 镜像护身符已修正：实际死亡后才转移物品；传送失败不会吞物，珍珠无法掉落时保留在护符槽中。
localized.en_us: Mirrored Amulets transfer items only after death. Failed transfers preserve items; a pearl that cannot drop remains in the amulet slot.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 透镜交换已修正：保留每片透镜的数据，并先为旧透镜安排存放位置，避免遗失或复制。
localized.en_us: Lens swapping preserves each lens and its data and reserves space for the old lens before exchanging it.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 水之共鸣之镜已修正：摘下透镜不会清除其他来源的夜视。
localized.en_us: Removing an Echo Lens preserves night vision from other sources.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 学者之镜已修正：扫描速度按游戏刻计时，不随画面帧率改变。
localized.en_us: Scholar’s Lens scans use game ticks; frame rate no longer changes scanning speed.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 熔析核心已修正：不直接熔掉带库存的方块；产物被保护阻止时保留原料。
localized.en_us: Liquefaction avoids inventory-bearing blocks and preserves input when protection prevents the output.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 解离核心已修正：成功支付并生成产物后才删除原料；晶化源质不能再次分解。
localized.en_us: Disintegration removes input only after payment and output succeed. Crystallized essentia cannot be disintegrated again.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 虚空油灰已修正：修复保留物品数据，不能用一份油灰修复异常堆叠的整叠装备。
localized.en_us: Void Putty preserves item data and cannot repair an entire abnormal stack of equipment with one putty.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 漩涡弱化已修正：撤除光束时不会覆盖其他设备或永久改变的节点性质。
localized.en_us: Removing attenuation beams does not overwrite node changes made by other devices or permanent effects.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 裂隙转化已修正：成功生成精灵或傀儡才消耗投入物；形成时保留不可破坏方块，容器正常掉落。
localized.en_us: Rifts consume materials only after creating their wisps or golems. Formation preserves unbreakable blocks and drops container contents normally.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 位面生成已修正：肉质层厚度按自身要素占比计算，不再被织物层比例覆盖；已有区块保持。
localized.en_us: New pocket planes calculate flesh-layer thickness from its own aspect share instead of the cloth share. Existing chunks remain unchanged.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 船只适配新版：使用现代双座船与划桨操作，保留材料加速和防摔碎能力。
localized.en_us: Boats use modern two-seat rowing controls while retaining material speed bonuses and fall protection.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 船只适配新版：使用现代双座船与划桨操作，保留材料加速和防摔碎能力。
localized.en_us: Boats use modern two-seat rowing controls while retaining material speed bonuses and fall protection.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘视界
localized.en_us: Thaumic Horizons

localized.zh_cn: 学者鸡配方适配新版：墨囊可替换为任意黑色染料。
localized.en_us: Scholar Chicken infusion accepts any black dye in place of an ink sac.
